verdict.rationale: Ghostty is a local terminal emulator that runs entirely on the user's own machine. Its source is public on GitHub ([ghostty-gh-1], [ghostty-gh-2]), and community members report building it from source themselves ([ghostty-comm-3]); official binaries and a Homebrew cask are also available ([ghostty-docs-30], [ghostty-docs-39]). The core engine, libghostty, is published as an embeddable library ([ghostty-gh-4], [ghostty-docs-36]), so nothing depends on vendor-hosted infrastructure. Building from source has some friction, including specific dependencies and a fairly new gtk4 ([ghostty-comm-3], [ghostty-comm-4]). missing for 10: explicit license/open-source statement in evidence, first-party build-from-source documentation, explicit confirmation of no account or cloud dependency.
